newsitem.title: UK: UK Treasury confirms BOE wanted April 1/4 pt hike.
newsitem.headline: UK Treasury confirms BOE wanted April 1/4 pt hike.

text.p: The UK Treasury confirmed on Wednesday that Bank of England Governor Eddie George had requested a 1/4 point, not a 1/2 point rise in interest rates at the April monetary meeting.
The Treasury's Internet version of the April minutes, released Wednesday morning, has caused some confusion because it shows George asking for a 1/2 point rate increase.
"The printed version shows he asked for a 1/4 point rise and that is correct," a Treasury spokesman said.
The Treasury will be correcting the internet text.
British interest rates were increased by 1/4 point two weeks ago, taking them to 6.25 percent.
